function: Learned blind receive beamforming at the user terminal: outputs array weights that point at the desired NGSO satellite and null co-frequency interferers (p. 3).
system: 8x8 planar array (64 elements) at the user terminal; one desired and one interfering NGSO satellite; 11.75 GHz carrier, 50 MHz bandwidth; no RIS (p. 12).
method: Transformer-encoder beamformer (multi-head attention) mapping the sample covariance matrix to weights; self-supervised offline training maximizing SINR, no labels (p. 9).
data_channel: Own simulation: MATLAB satellite toolbox orbits with a line-of-sight array-response channel and free-space path loss; 9000 training and 900 test samples, released online (p. 4, 12).
test_conditions: Trained on 30 passes, tested on 3 other passes of the same constellations and terminal; separate datasets for L = M, 2M, 4M snapshots (p. 12).
baselines: Non-learned: ZFBF, MRC, SMI. Learned: NNBF(H) [22], CNNBF(R) [23], plus the AttBF(Y) and AttBF(FFT) input variants of the proposed model (p. 6, 10).
metrics: Output SINR (minimum, maximum, mean), SINR histograms and beam patterns, inference time, trainable parameters, training time (p. 14).
complexity: Per-sample O(M^2) for the proposed model; 184 thousand parameters; inference about 4.5 microseconds against 133 microseconds for SMI (p. 11, 13, 14).
openness: Data: all generated datasets, https://fnr-smartspace-project.uni.lu/datasets/ (p. 3, 18); code: none.
q1_support: p. 4: "the LoS component becomes dominant, thus the non-LoS" - custom line-of-sight array-response channel with free-space path loss; no 3GPP model and no measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "satellite passes) and NTs = 900 testing data samples" - the test set is 3 passes of the same constellations and terminal; no new scenario, band or array is tested.
q3_support: p. 3: "method with DL-based models [22], [23] and traditional" non-learning methods ZFBF and SMI, all compared on output SINR (Table 7, p. 14).
q4_support: p. 11: "AttBF(Y) and AttBF(FFT) is O(L2 ), and is equal to O(M 2 )" - Big-O per sample for the other models, including the proposed one; parameters in Table 6 (p. 13), inference time in p. 14.
q5_support: p. 3: "produced in this work are made publicly available" at [27], the project datasets page listed on p. 18; datasets only, no code.
notes: Included, area 6: learned receive beam control of a satellite link wins over area 3 by the tie-break order. The interference is unintentional co-frequency interference between NGSO systems, not jamming. Tables 1 to 8 are not in the extracted text, so I read them from the page images (pp. 11, 13, 14, 17). AttBF(Y) and AttBF(FFT) are variants of the proposed model, so the learned baselines of q3 are NNBF(H) [22] and CNNBF(R) [23]. The test set comes from a separate simulation of the same setup (p. 11), and Table 6 lists parameters and training time for each L; no test across different L is reported.
